name: C1-RN8W
description: C1-RN8W was an astromech droid of the C1 series with a black chassis and rainbow-colored detailing. This droid lived in the domed city located on the planet Plazir-15. In 9 ABY, C1 travelled to the Peacekeeping zone on the same day Din Djarin and Bo-Katan Kryze visited the metropolis.
